eligibility.rule: completed D-I games (FBS or FCS opponents)

efficiency.formula: AdjEM = (AdjO - AdjD) * muT; AdjO/AdjD = weighted mean of adjusted game values plus one phantom game at the division average

definitions.PtsPerOpp: opp_points / scoring_opps (drives with a 1st down at or inside opp 40)

luck.rule: garbage-adjusted score = final score minus offensive points on garbage-time drives (per-game removals listed in the schedule)

situational.pace_rule: mean clean snap-to-snap seconds, Q1-Q3, score within 14, not the final 2:00 of Q2, games whose clock is usable

lead_protection_drives.reason: Q4, up 17, 39.5 s/snap over 2 clean intervals (threshold 38.0), 6/7 runs
Q4, up 3, 38.0 s/snap over 3 clean intervals (threshold 38.0), 3/5 runs
Q4, up 14, 41.0 s/snap over 2 clean intervals (threshold 38.0), 6/6 runs

situational.weight_note: weight 0.5: tagged drives are down-weighted in AdjO/AdjD/AdjSR

rules.rates: accepted fouls on kept drives per 100 snaps; a Q4 leader's offensive delay of game is situational and left out
rules.rating: descriptive only; not in the rating

games.note: FCS loss counts as a loss
